scene:
Three zones read left to right, separated by generous space.

LEFT ZONE (narrow), the gap, two icons stacked vertically: a single person at a desk with a long queue of customer folders piling up in front of them, labelled ONE SPECIALIST BOTTLENECK; below it a large stopwatch, labelled 80 HOURS PER SETUP. One arrow leads right into the middle zone.

MIDDLE ZONE (widest), four route cards in a 2-by-2 grid, each with one icon, a route label and, underneath, a small verdict tag:
Top-left card: two people talking across a small table, labelled PEER CONVERSATION, with the tag FIRST.
Top-right card, highlighted in teal with a large ochre check mark: one specialist with a toolbox beside an engineer at a laptop, labelled INVESTOR'S SPECIALIST €15K CAP, with the tag CHOSEN.
Bottom-left card, drawn with a dashed outline: a person with a magnifying glass searching a directory, labelled INDEPENDENT SPECIALIST, with the tag FALLBACK.
Bottom-right card, drawn with a dashed outline: an empty office chair with a small hourglass, labelled PERMANENT HIRE €150K A YEAR, with the tag LATER.

RIGHT ZONE, exactly one arrow runs from the chosen card to a single handwritten note card with a pen, labelled REQUEST: ONE REPEATABLE SETUP PATH. Below the note, ONE single straight horizontal timeline (one line only, never split onto two rows) with three evenly spaced milestones on it, left to right: a person starting work, labelled DAY 21: START; a clipboard over a small row of customer figures, labelled DAY 90: MEASURE; a board table, labelled DAY 100: BOARD REVIEW.

All papers, folders and screens are blank or show only wavy lines; no digits except in the labels.

TEXT: draw exactly these labels, each once and nothing else: ONE SPECIALIST BOTTLENECK, 80 HOURS PER SETUP, PEER CONVERSATION, FIRST, INVESTOR'S SPECIALIST €15K CAP, CHOSEN, INDEPENDENT SPECIALIST, FALLBACK, PERMANENT HIRE €150K A YEAR, LATER, REQUEST: ONE REPEATABLE SETUP PATH, DAY 21: START, DAY 90: MEASURE, DAY 100: BOARD REVIEW. Any other text is a defect. There are no other arrows anywhere besides the arrow from the gap zone into the grid and the one arrow from the chosen card to the request note.
alt: A gap, one specialist as a bottleneck and 80 hours per customer setup, is compared across four routes: a peer conversation first, the investor’s specialist capped at €15,000 and chosen, an independent specialist held as a fallback, and a permanent hire at €150,000 a year left for later; the result is a request for one repeatable setup path, with the specialist starting on day 21, measurement on day 90 and the board review on day 100.
caption: Name the gap through the work that fails, compare routes for the same need, and end with a short written request.
